title: The IFA Spoken Language Corpus
inclusion_basis: Primary non-singing Dutch production; corpus explicitly described as hand-segmented, with 1000 hours of human labeling and inter/intra-labeler evaluation; phonemic segmentation was performed for 4 female and 4 male speakers.
annotation_format: Praat annotation files plus relational/TSV database exports
notes: Open Zenodo record includes compact annotation archives (Labels-chunks.zip, Labels-sentences.zip, Labels-validation.zip), labeling protocol, database exports, auxiliary corpus files, and large audio archives. Audio should remain authoritative-reference/checksum only unless needed; prioritize annotation/database archives for next observation-level parse.
